notes: The prompt is a place and a mood - a moon base in a crater, described down to the skybox - and the clarifying question about what happens here came back as nothing at all, so it never landed on a genre and this is No Genre rather than an Entertainment showcase invented to avoid the file. That makes the axes the shape: exterior, single zone, dressed geometry, and tiered verticality for the crater bowl and uneven ground, which routes P0 plus tiered with nothing overhanging. Explorable Place is the environment-showcase preset and fits as written - the research pods, dishes and glowing crystal formations are the focal build, walkable routes thread the twenty-second compound, and composed viewpoints suit a scene built to be looked at - with terrain-relief added for the crater the author put it inside. Nothing needs an interior, so no P3, and I decided the low-poly styling and starry skybox are image-pass dressing rather than layout features.
